title: Aurora Appoints Seasoned Biopharmaceutical Executive to Lead Commercial Acceleration of Global Medical Cannabis Business

body_markdown:
EDMONTON, AB


, Sept. 9, 2026


/CNW/ -- Aurora Cannabis Inc. (NASDAQ: ACB) (TSX:ACB ), the Canadian-based leading global medical cannabis company, announces Faris El Refaie, a biopharmaceutical leader with 25 years of experience, will join the company as Executive Vice President, Global Commercial, effective September 28, 2026.


Continue Reading


Aurora welcomes Faris El Refaie as EVP, Global Commercial


In this newly created role, Faris will oversee Aurora's global commercial function, with responsibility for furthering the company's medical cannabis market strategy, aligning its global portfolio, growing customer engagement and accelerating commercial capabilities across Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and other international markets as Aurora expands its global footprint.


"We're beyond excited to welcome Faris to Aurora at such a pivotal time in the company's global growth journey," says Miguel Martin, Executive Chairman and CEO of Aurora. "Faris brings decades of executive leadership in the biopharmaceutical industry, with a particular focus on commercial growth and market leadership, that will no doubt be additive to our global strategy and the company's overall ability to lead. At Aurora, we have built a leading global medical cannabis platform grounded in science, quality and patient care. In this newly created executive role, Faris will continue this momentum by strengthening Aurora's presence in key markets to bring high-quality medical cannabis to more patients around the world."


Faris joins Aurora with extensive experience across highly regulated pharmaceutical organizations, spanning innovative medicines, oncology, specialty care, vaccines and consumer healthcare. He has held progressive leadership roles at JAMP Pharma Group, GSK and AstraZeneca, building deep commercial expertise across global markets including Canada, the U.S., Europe and Asia. Throughout his career, Faris has led commercial transformations, global product strategies and cross-functional teams, giving him the experience and perspective to help Aurora build on its strong foundation and unlock new opportunities across its international medical cannabis business.


Faris' appointment reflects Aurora's continued focus on strengthening its global commercial platform as the Company expands its leadership across established and emerging international medical cannabis markets in service of Aurora's purpose of Opening the World to Cannabis™.


**About Aurora**


Aurora is a global leader in medical cannabis, dedicated to improving lives through scientific expertise, proven performance, and a deep commitment to patient care. Aurora serves medical markets across Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand with a portfolio of trusted, leading brands including Aurora®, MedReleaf®, Pedanios®, IndiMed™, San Raf®, and Whistler Medical Marijuana Corporation®. With world-class GMP-certified manufacturing facilities in Canada and Germany, and a team of industry-leading professionals, Aurora continues to expand its global footprint and deliver consistent, high-quality cannabis products with the purpose of Opening the World to Cannabis™.
